objects.name: WhatsApp lookalike kit: technical analysis
objects.description: Over three days in late October 2026, 51 domain names imitating WhatsApp were registered in three batches, each batch within a single minute. NSS recorded every one within 27 hours of its registration, tied the 51 together from public registration and hosting records, and read a copy of the WhatsApp sign-in page on 11 of them. This paper sets out what was observed, how the names were tied together, and what a defender can look for. Updated 16 November 2026: 29 more names since publication, and the relay behind them has moved to a new domain.
